item.title: Competitor A launches an AI assistant for enterprise support
item.description: Competitor A announced a new AI assistant aimed at enterprise support teams. The product routes tickets automatically and drafts replies. Pricing starts at $49 per seat.

item.title: Competitor A announces a partnership with a payments provider
item.description: The partnership adds embedded checkout to the platform across twelve European markets.

item.title: Competitor A raises a Series B round
item.description: The round was led by an existing investor and will fund international expansion.
